Proof of Work

Projects

Real problems, and what actually resolved them.

Self-Hosted SIEM for a 12-Device Homelab

Problem — Off-the-shelf monitoring tools were either too shallow for real threat visibility or priced for enterprise budgets, leaving small setups blind to lateral movement.

Outcome — Built a self-hosted SIEM stack (Wazuh + Proxmox VLANs) giving full log visibility and alerting for under $0 in licensing, now used as a reference architecture for client engagements.

Wazuh Proxmox Networking Self-Hosted

48-Hour Incident Response for an SME Ransomware Case

Problem — A small business suffered a ransomware incident with no prior backup strategy and no internal security staff to triage it.

Outcome — Contained the breach, recovered critical data from a partial backup, and rebuilt the network with segmented access — the business resumed operations within 48 hours with zero ransom paid.

Incident Response Ransomware Backup Strategy
